decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records that the gameplay demonstration must use the phone from the opening message scene.
Using the same phone for the opening message and gameplay does not change the existing requirement to follow the remaining script exactly.
The device-continuity change does not alter the required Igbo language or its accuracy.
The same-phone decision does not affect the delivery deadline; the separate same-message request for delivery that day is already represented in this candidate's history.
